name: mRNA-FM / PlantRNA-FM
condition: Split the family or verify each member with its own primary evidence, artifact locator, and licence.
licence_quote: PlantRNA-FM card: "License: mit". mrnafm card: "This model is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 License" (SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later).
rationale: Checked both HF model cards today. PlantRNA-FM is now fully evidenced as an individual member: MIT licence, 34M-param safetensors weights downloadable ungated, primary paper linked on the card (bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.06.24.600509v2; the register already holds the published article PMC11652376). mRNA-FM: weights downloadable ungated under AGPL-3.0, but its card's only linked paper is the family RNA-FM preprint (doi.org/10.1101/2022.08.06.503062 / arXiv 2204.00300), not an mRNA-FM-specific primary publication — 'its own primary evidence' is not established. The two members carry conflicting licences (MIT vs AGPL-3.0), so the combined family record cannot be promoted as-is; the split has not been executed in the register. Recommend splitting: PlantRNA-FM would be promotable as a standalone record on today's evidence; mRNA-FM would need its primary-evidence question resolved. Ambiguity resolves to HOLD.

name: SATURN

name: xTrimoGene

The OpenReview forum page could not be fetched (browser-verification screen blocked the fetch). WebSearch budget was exhausted, so no broader sweep for a new official xTrimoGene repo was possible this session. Condition not satisfied on fetched evidence.

name: scPROTEIN
condition: Reconsider if broader reusable pretraining is evidenced or a written scope-policy revision explicitly includes this class.
rationale: Fetched the official repo today. It remains a dataset-specific framework: users train stage1/stage2 on individual datasets, and the only released checkpoints are 'for scPROTEIN stage1 and stage2 on SCoPE2_Specht dataset' — one dataset, not broad reusable pretraining. No scope-policy revision exists (that is an internal register document, not something external evidence can supply). Condition not satisfied.

name: DeepSEA
condition: Reconsider only under a written historical-exception policy with the original artifact correctly identified.
licence_quote: No licence stated on the DeepSEA download page; it says only "The code for the standalone version of DeepSEA can be downloaded here (766M)." and cites Zhou & Troyanskaya, Nature Methods (2015).
rationale: The condition has two parts. Part 2 (original artifact correctly identified) can now be resolved: fetched deepsea.princeton.edu/help/ today — the original standalone DeepSEA code download (766M) is live there, distinct from the Selene framework the record currently links; the page also states 'We now recommend our new library Selene for training purposes.' No licence/terms are stated for the standalone download. Part 1, a written historical-exception policy, is an internal register document that no external evidence can satisfy, so the entry stays held. If the policy is adopted, replace the Selene code link with the deepsea.princeton.edu artifact and note the absent licence.

name: ChromBPNet
condition: Reconsider if a written scope policy includes assay-specific predictors or broader reusable pretraining is evidenced.
licence_quote: Repo licence: MIT (GitHub licence indicator). Repo on transferability: "Bias models are generally transferable across assay types following similar protocol."
rationale: Fetched the official repo today. ChromBPNet is still trained per-assay/per-dataset via the 'chrombpnet pipeline' command on the user's own BAM/fragment files; the only reusable pretrained artifacts are the bias models, which are a correction component, not a foundation model. So broader reusable pretraining is not evidenced, and the written scope policy is an internal register decision. Attempted to check whether the Dec 2024 bioRxiv preprint (10.1101/2024.12.25.630221) is now journal-published, but bioRxiv returned HTTP 403 — publication status UNVERIFIED this session; it would not change the scope verdict either way.

name: FloraBERT
condition: Reconsider if broader reusable foundation-model scope is established by primary evidence.
licence_quote: Repo licence: MIT (GitHub licence indicator). Repo self-description: "Predicting gene expression levels from upstream promoter regions using deep learning."
rationale: Fetched the official repo today. Scope is unchanged: plant promoter modelling and tissue-specific gene-expression prediction (a general plant promoter LM, a maize-specific LM, and a multitask regression head), with pretrained models distributed via a Google Drive link rather than a versioned model hub. Only 3 commits; no sign of renaming, archival, or new primary evidence establishing broader reusable FM scope. Condition not satisfied. Publication status of the Research Square preprint was not re-checked (would not affect the scope condition).
